items.title: Breakfast: eat early
items.note: Go to the buffet at opening to avoid the crowds.

food.name: Panda Hotel breakfast buffet (熊猫酒店自助早餐)

items.title: Hotel → Chimelong Paradise North Gate
items.note: Shuttle; queue at the gate before opening. Saturdays are busy, so the earlier the better.

items.title: Thrill rides
items.note: Queues are shortest in the first two hours; the most popular rides are done first. December is cold, so water rides such as the rapids are best skipped.

route.title: Scream Zone: Rocket coaster (尖叫地带：火箭过山车)
route.desc: One of the most popular rides; go straight at opening.

route.title: Rhythm World: Dive coaster (律动天地：垂直过山车)
Super giant pendulum (超级大摆锤)
route.desc: Flips a full 360°; phones and wallets go in a locker first.

items.title: Family rides
items.note: Gentle rides around the Happy Carnival area.

route.title: Star Dream Garden (星梦奇园)
route.walk: Follow the signs from the North Gate
route.desc: Family rides such as the dream carousel and bouncing rides.

route.title: Kids' play area (儿童游乐区)
route.desc: Suited to young children at a slow pace.

items.title: Lunch: eat early
items.note: Start at 11:30 to avoid the crowds.

food.name: Coconut Grove Restaurant (椰林餐厅)
food.desc: In-park restaurant, recommended on the official route

items.title: Rest break
items.note: Find seating in the park, rest and rehydrate.

items.title: Happy Theatre: magic show (欢乐剧场：魔术表演)
items.note: Seated indoor show with audience interaction. Times per the Chimelong app; official guides mention shows around 14:00 and 16:30. Enter 10 min early.

items.title: Repeat favourite rides
items.note: Crowds thin in the afternoon; the morning's favourites are ridden again.

items.title: Exit via North Gate; shuttle to hotel
Back to the hotel: change, rest
items.note: Old town this evening; bring a jacket.

items.title: Panda Hotel → Shawan Ancient Town (沙湾古镇)
items.note: Taxi, ~30–40 min. Navigate to “沙湾古镇”.

items.title: Shawan Ancient Town: dusk to night market
items.note: Lingnan old town founded in the Southern Song, 800+ years old; free entry. Compact; covered entirely on foot.

route.title: Liugeng Hall (留耕堂, He Clan Ancestral Hall)
route.desc: Five-courtyard ancestral hall: the “诗书世泽” plaque, huge timber columns and oyster-shell windows in the rear hall. Visited first while it is still light.

route.title: Wenfeng Pagoda and old streets (文峰塔、古街)
route.desc: Seven-storey pagoda overlooking the wok-ear gabled roofs. Nearby: the old pawnshop, Jinshi Gate and old rice mill. The pagoda's wind chimes are atmospheric at dusk.

route.title: Anning Square light night market (安宁广场光影夜市)
route.desc: Market runs ~17:30–19:00: embroidery, copperware and tea stalls. Saturday the 26th is a weekend, so the adjacent Guangdong Music Hall may have a performance.

route.title: Dinner: old-town snacks
route.walk: Around the night market and old streets; eaten on the go

food.name: Pajinshan fish soup (爬金山鱼羹)
food.desc: Fish soup cooked with dried tangerine peel and lemon leaves

food.name: Puppy congee (狗仔粥)
food.desc: Rice-flour dough shaped like puppies, cooked with shrimp and Chinese sausage

food.name: Shawan Ginger Milk Curd Old House (沙湾姜撞奶老屋甜品店)
food.desc: Set in a converted century-old house with a small courtyard

food.name: Ginger milk curd (姜撞奶)
food.desc: Shawan's signature dessert: ginger juice is poured into hot milk, which sets like tofu

route.title: Liugeng Hall 3D projection (留耕堂3D投影)
route.desc: Projected on the hall's outer wall; tells the town's musical history. Whether it runs is confirmed on site.

items.tip: Streets are flagstone; wear comfortable shoes. It gets cold after dark; bring a jacket.

items.title: Shawan Ancient Town → Panda Hotel
items.note: Taxi, ~30 min; back at the hotel around 20:00.

intro:
Chimelong Paradise: Option A family rides / Option B thrill rides
Afternoon: magic show, repeat favourite rides
Evening: Shawan Ancient Town — Liugeng Hall, night market, local snacks
